name: xteink-mailbox
description: Capability-URL mailbox that the CrossPoint reader polls at deep-sleep entry.
//: type=module is LOAD-BEARING: the repo root package.json has no `type`, so without this node would parse mailbox/src/*.js as CommonJS and `scripts/mailbox_dev_server.mjs` would die on the first `export`. It also keeps wrangler's module resolution unambiguous. This package is not part of the app's dependency tree and is never installed by the root `npm ci`.
